title: Polynomial size of a circuit family
statement: A Boolean tree circuit family has polynomial size if there are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that, for every input length $n$, the size of its circuit is at most $a(n+1)^k$.
hypotheses_covered: There exist natural numbers a and k
The size bound holds for every natural number input length n
